rationale: Concept is plausible and supported by guidance (MISEV2023) and prior data, and reviewers recommend the spike-in–controlled, multi-epitope protection workflow as a qualitative identity gate; however, moderate technical/operational risks and explicit evidence gaps remain (validated, traceable spike-in that mimics endogenous EVs; capture-reagent buffer compatibility panels; fraction-level orthogonal characterization). Proceed to experimental testing with those controls and resource allocation before any CMC adoption.
